name: jlc-6l-hdi
service: Standard PCB, FR-4, 6 layers, fine-pitch (BGA) rules, epoxy filled vias
title: JLCPCB 6 layer 1.6 mm, fine-pitch limits (0.09 mm tracks, 0.15/0.25 mm vias), epoxy filled and capped vias

engine.qualification: JLCPCB 6 layer (draft) with its multilayer fine-pitch limits: 0.09 mm track/space, 0.15/0.25 mm vias, epoxy filled and capped vias (free on 6+ layers); other rules the jlc-4l 5A values (6-layer rules not transcribed).

fab.min_track_width_mm: J-cap (multilayer: minimum track width/spacing 0.09/0.09 mm, 3.5/3.5 mil)
fab.clearance_mm: J-cap (multilayer: minimum track width/spacing 0.09/0.09 mm; BGA pad to trace min 0.09 mm)
fab.smd_pad_clearance_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.edge_clearance_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.hole_to_edge_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.hole_clearance_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.pth_hole_clearance_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.npth_hole_clearance_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.hole_to_hole_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.pth_hole_to_hole_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.component_pth_min_drill_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.via_diameter_mm: derived: the fine-pitch default via, a 0.20 mm drill (the jlc-4l escape class's) with a 0.10 mm ring, within the J-cap multilayer minimum 0.15/0.25 mm
fab.via_drill_mm: derived: the fine-pitch default via, a 0.20 mm drill (the jlc-4l escape class's) with a 0.10 mm ring, within the J-cap multilayer minimum 0.15/0.25 mm
fab.min_via_diameter_mm: J-cap (multilayer: minimum via hole size/diameter 0.15/0.25 mm)
fab.min_through_drill_mm: J-cap (multilayer: minimum via hole size/diameter 0.15/0.25 mm)
fab.min_npth_drill_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)
fab.via_to_smd_pad_mm: derived: the jlc-4l value (6-layer rules not transcribed)

board_min_mm.src: derived: not transcribed; the quote page checks it

board_max_mm.src: derived: not transcribed; the quote page checks it

via_fill.src: J-cover (free epoxy resin filling on 6-layer and above boards; filled holes 0.5 mm or less)

order_number_marking.src: J-quote (the 'Mark on PCB' option: 'No mark will be added by default.')
